description: $0.09 via x402: live macro/economic indicators for any of 200+ countries in one call — GDP, GDP growth %, inflation (CPI), unemployment %, GDP per capita, population, with the year of each. Official public-domain World Bank data. For macro, finance, research and trading agents.

country.description: ISO2 or ISO3 country code, e.g. USA, DE, JPN, CN, GBR, IND, BRA

x_payment.description: signed x402 payment payload (the X-PAYMENT header value) for the terms the first call returns; omit it to get the price and terms
